name: Emory University
character: The Beaux-Arts campus is heavily forested with pine, maples, oak, and magnolias, crossed by Peavine Creek, with buildings featuring multi-hued granite and Spanish Saltillo tile.

landmarks.name: Robert W. Woodruff Library
landmarks.quote: In the Candler Library Annex of Robert W. Woodruff Library, there is a 1920s Pietro Caproni reproduction

landmarks.name: Michael C. Carlos Museum
landmarks.quote: The campus is home to Emory University Hospital, Michael C. Carlos Museum, which has the largest collection of ancient artifacts

landmarks.name: Candler Library Annex
landmarks.quote: In the Candler Library Annex of Robert W. Woodruff Library, there is a 1920s Pietro Caproni reproduction

landmarks.name: Cox Hall Ballroom
landmarks.quote: The Cox Hall Ballroom was transformed into a news center for the Olympic foreign press.

landmarks.name: Peavine Creek
landmarks.quote: and Peavine Creek, a branch of the Peachtree Creek, runs through the campus.
landmarks.look: A creek running through a heavily forested campus.

landmarks.name: Schwartz Center for Performing Arts
landmarks.quote: Emory routinely hosts arts events in the Schwartz Center for Performing Arts

landmarks.name: Emory Student Center
landmarks.quote: The Emory Student Center (ESC), opened in May 2019, includes a dining hall, study and collaboration spaces

landmarks.name: Sanford S. Atwood Chemistry Center
landmarks.quote: a $52 million expansion and renovation project of the Sanford S. Atwood Chemistry Center was completed.
